title: Hanasato Minori — Scurry! Dash! Skitter!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Odaiba Animal Land

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! So this is the Carnivore Zone...?!
It totally looks like the wild!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, the atmosphere here feels really different from everywhere else.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm getting a little anxious... It's like we're being watched by all the animals.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, they have different routes for large and small animals. Which should we choose?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Based on the map, the one for smaller animals looks shorter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You two have to go back to work, so why don't we go see the smaller animals?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right!
Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, this is apparently the section for the Tsushima leopard cats! What do you think they're like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm also curious... But I'm not seeing them anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, I'm pretty sure they're in here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, how do you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Because that bush over there just moved.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The bush...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, she's right!
They're walking towards—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, kittens! She's with her babies!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're so cute...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, that one's trying to get Mom's attention.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta take a picture!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! Where'd all these people come from...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
And they're all taking pictures.
Do you think they were waiting for the kittens?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That means all these people are here to see them. They're like idols!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, they're going back into the bushes...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, already?!
I wanted to keep watching.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. All things considered, we were pretty fortunate.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we were super lucky to see them as soon as we came!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: As nice as it would be to stay, let's head over to the next section.

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Hey, did you hear?
The Pallas's cats are back!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Really? We gotta go see them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Pallas's cats...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are they like?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I've definitely heard of them before.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They must be really cute if all these people are going over to see them! Wanna head over?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! This place is packed...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There's way more people here now. I didn't realize they were so popular...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I can see why. I mean, look how cute they are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. You must really like them, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, this one just showed me its belly...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No fair! Show me your belly too, kitty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Uh oh. It's hissing.
Is it trying to intimidate us?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Us? Or just Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Whyyy?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe this just isn't your day for interacting with animals, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But!
I don't want the cats to be mad! I just wanna be friends with them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Whoa! It just banged its paws against the window!

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line: Wow, they're more ferocious than I thought. Is this one in hunting mode?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sounds like it's stalking you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Again, why only me?!
